title: spec: the `forceCbpMasterDetailRequired` docblock in `data/object.zod.ts` says "Today only the security gate closes that shape", but since protocol 18 the parse refusal `refuseControlledByParentWithoutOneMaster` closes it too
body:
**Filing gate ①**: wrong text with a named landing, and it is published: `@objectstack/spec`'s `files[]` ships `src/**/*.zod.ts`.
- **`reach:`** the `@objectstack/spec` tarball (`src/data/object.zod.ts`).
- It is the second member of #24187's family, "a docblock that names the wrong mechanism", so it gets its own card (the family rule: open on the second occurrence when no close-out card exists).

**Filed by** `domain:spec` seat 2 (#18549) · `zhuangjianguo` · session `session_019oFY6Hi35J7atvgVFnmoaK`, from PR #24290.
- The dev noted it in the PR's Acceptance notes (report `6247975508`).
- The contract review `6248097646` verified it and escalated it.
- The seat's ACCEPT `6248010034` had kept it as a note. That was wrong: a noticed, untouched published docblock that states a false fact gets a card. This card corrects it.

⛔ Not a claim. Lane, grade and `area:*` are triage's.

## Measured on `origin/main` `93b4acb57e`

`packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts:3483`–`:3485`, the `forceCbpMasterDetailRequired` docblock's "Why" paragraph, reads:

> `422 MISSING_REQUIRED_FIELD`. Today only the security gate (`assertControlledByParentWrite`) closes that shape, and commit 75b7c240a records that the declaration and the enforcement disagree.

- The same docblock's next paragraph (`:3497`–`:3501`) says the rule "is judged on the parse itself by `refuseControlledByParentWithoutOneMaster`", so a raw parse of a `master_detail` without `required: true` is refused.
- So "Today only the security gate … closes that shape" stopped being true when that parse refusal landed. The paragraph contradicts itself, and the first statement is the stale one.
- Re-check: `git grep -n "Today only the security gate" origin/main -- packages` → 1 hit, this line. Control: `git grep -c "refuseControlledByParentWithoutOneMaster" origin/main -- packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts` → non-zero.

## The work

One PR, comment text only:
- Put the sentence in the past tense (what closed that shape before the parse refusal), or drop it and keep the commit pointer.
- Name `refuseControlledByParentWithoutOneMaster` as what closes the shape today.
- No key, export, accepted value or message text changes: `Clause-②: no`, and a `patch` changeset for `@objectstack/spec` (the PR #24290 / PR #24072 precedent).

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:spec` seat, one PR on `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts` (docblock only).

## Grade (a suggestion; triage's call)

p3, as #24187: the paragraph corrects itself two sentences later, so an author is not led into a wrong write. But the false sentence ships.

## Dedupe

- REST scan of the 193 most recently updated objectstack issues (open and closed, back to 2026-10-17T00:32Z) for `docblock`, `master detail required` or `controlled_by_parent`: 2 hits. #24187 is this family's first card, closing with PR #24290. #24047 is closed: it fixed the `ActionParam` docblock's `normaliseOptions` sentence. Neither names this sentence.

Dedupe words: forceCbpMasterDetailRequired docblock only the security gate; refuseControlledByParentWithoutOneMaster parse refusal docblock tense.
